description: Belgian real estate from Zimmo with exact addresses, sold comps, commune prices per m² and a local store for deal sourcing.

tools.name: dealers_get
tools.description: Get one real-estate agency (dealer) by UUID. Required: id. Returns the Dealer.

tools.name: dealers_search
tools.description: Search agencies (filter by category, placeId; sort by distance). Returns the new DealersSearchResponse.

tools.name: geocode_geocode
tools.description: Geocode a Belgian address to coordinates and place ids. Required: address. Returns the GeocodeGeocodeResponse.

tools.name: listings_get
tools.description: Get one listing by Zimmo code (e.g. LAISZ) or listing UUID. Required: id. Returns the Listing.

tools.name: listings_property-count
tools.description: Total number of active properties on Zimmo. Returns the ListingsPropertyCountResponse.

tools.name: listings_search
tools.description: Search listings with a Zimmo filter object (status, placeId, postalCode, category, price, bedrooms, energyLabel, text). Optional: filter, paging, sorting. Returns the new SearchResponse.

tools.name: locality-price_locality_price
tools.description: Price per m² for a commune (by property type) with monthly history. Required: placeId, startDate. Returns the LocalityPrice.

params.name: startDate
params.description: History start date YYYY-MM-DD (Zimmo requires it)

tools.name: places_find
tools.description: Resolve a postcode and/or commune name to Zimmo place ids. Optional: postalCode, name. Returns array of PlacesFindItem.

tools.name: sub-locality-price_sub_locality_price
tools.description: Price per m² for a sub-locality with monthly history. Required: placeId, startDate. Returns the LocalityPrice.

params.name: startDate
params.description: History start date YYYY-MM-DD (Zimmo requires it)

tools.name: sublocalities_search
tools.description: Search sub-localities (deelgemeenten) by keyword. Required: keyword. Optional: locale (default: fr). Returns the SublocalitiesSearchResponse.

novel_features.name: Bulk detail enrichment
novel_features.description: Refresh stored listings from Zimmo, resumably: status changes, price history, EPC, flood and planning flags, GPS.

novel_features.name: Cross-portal match
novel_features.description: Find the Immoweb or Immovlan twin of a Zimmo listing and the price gap between portals.

novel_features.name: Sold comps
novel_features.description: Sold or rented listings around one property with median €/m² and the subject's gap to it.

novel_features.name: PEB trap
novel_features.description: Energy-poor stored listings (EPC F/G or high kWh/m²), rented ones first with their rent, showing Zimmo's renovation-obligation flag.

novel_features.name: Underpriced vs commune
novel_features.description: Rank stored for-sale houses and apartments by discount to their commune's €/m² (viager, whole buildings and service flats skipped).

novel_features.name: Gross rental yield
novel_features.description: Gross rental yield of sale listings: the published rent when let, otherwise rentals of similar surface in the same postcode and type.

novel_features.name: Motivated seller score
novel_features.description: Rank listings by seller pressure: days on market, total price cut, re-listing, EPC.
